name: showhome
title: Show Home
description: A housebuilder's release price list on site-hoarding navy: every plot is one white-ruled row of beds, baths, area and price in tabular figures, with a dash for any gap, and a round green, amber or red sticker stuck askew at the end of each row that is for sale, reserved or sold.

tokens.--font-display: flared hoarding capitals: site name, titles, menu, headings
tokens.--font-text: humanist sans for body text, price list rows and figures
tokens.--text-xs: column heads, status words, small uppercase labels
tokens.--text-s: addresses, unit words, hours, tags, footer
tokens.--text-l: site name, intro lines, headings in text, the inquiry heading and phone
tokens.--text-xl: a listing's title and its price on the plate
tokens.--text-display: page titles lettered on the hoarding
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of uppercase labels, the menu and the site name
tokens.--color-band: darker navy of masthead and footer, and behind loading photos
tokens.--color-muted: secondary lettering: addresses, units, column heads, hours, closed rows
tokens.--color-accent: pale blue links on the hoarding, current menu underline, focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules between price list rows
tokens.--color-rule-strong: heavy white rules and the inquiry board's frame
tokens.--color-row-hover: tint of a row or tag under the pointer
tokens.--color-panel: white reading panels and a listing's price plate
tokens.--color-panel-text: text on panels and the price plate
tokens.--color-panel-muted: quotes and small headings in panels
tokens.--color-panel-link: links in panels and their focus ring
tokens.--color-panel-rule: rules and table lines in panels
tokens.--color-sticker-open: green sticker: For sale, To let, Available; the dot before the site name
tokens.--color-sticker-pending: amber sticker: Under offer, Let agreed
tokens.--color-sheen: light catching the top of a sticker
tokens.--shadow-sticker: shadow lifting a sticker off the sheet
tokens.--sticker: size of a sticker on a price list row
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a line of reading text
tokens.--gutter: space at the sides of the page
tokens.--seam-width: width of one hoarding panel between joints
tokens.--radius: slight rounding of panels, plate, photos, tags
